data("diamonds")

##SameFirstSecond <-
  Minneapolis2013 %>%
  filter(First == Second) %>%
  group_by(First, Second) %>%
  summarise(total = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  head(3)

##OleSaviorTopSecond <-
  Minneapolis2013 %>%
  filter(First == "OLE SAVIOR") %>%
  group_by(Second) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(count)) %>%
  head(3)

MostPopNameSex <-
  BabyNames %>%
  group_by(name, sex) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  mutate(name_rank = rank(desc(total)))%>%
  filter(name_rank <=5) %>%
  arrange(sex, name_rank)

NameChange <-
  BabyNames %>%
  group_by(year, name) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(count), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(desc(n))) %>%
  mutate(ranking = ifelse(rank <= 100,'Top_100', 'Below')) %>%
  group_by(year, ranking) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  arrange(desc(year))

BabyNames_ranked <- BabyNames %>%
   group_by(year, name) %>%
   summarise(updated_count = sum(count)) %>%
   mutate(ranking = if_else(condition = (rank(desc(updated_count))<=100), true = "Top_100", false = "Below"))%>%
   group_by(year, ranking) %>%
   summarise(total = sum(updated_count)) %>%
   arrange(desc(year))

FractionofTop100 <-
  NameChange %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ranking, values_from = total) %>%
  mutate(fraction = Top_100 / (Below + Top_100))

FractionofTop100 <-
  NameChange %>%
  spread(ranking, total) %>%
  mutate(fraction = Top_100 / (Below + Top_100))
  
PopularandNot <-
  BabyNames %>%
  group_by(year, name) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(desc(total))) %>%
  filter(rank <= 50 | rank >= 1000) %>%
  mutate(
    ispop = rank <= 50,
    notpop = rank >= 1000
    ) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    everpop = any(ispop),
    everunpop = any(notpop)
    ) %>%
  filter(everpop & everunpop)

TableA <-
  BabyNames %>%
  arrange(count)

TableB <-
  BabyNames %>%
  filter(sex == "F")

TableC <-
  BabyNames %>%
  filter(sex == "M")

TableD <-
  BabyNames %>%
  summarise (total = sum(count))

TableE <-
  BabyNames %>%
  select(name, count)

diamonds %>%
  group_by(clarity) %>%
  summarise(avg_table_per_carat = mean(table/carat), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_table_per_carat)) %>%
  head(1)

Minneapolis2013 %>%
  group_by(First) %>%
  summarise(total = n()) %>%
  ##arrange(total) %>%
  mutate(First = ifelse(total < 5000, "minor", First))
